verdict: clear: unified-category home and grouped natural search retain selected records, alternatives and work-key viewport anchors
reviewed_paths: all-source default browse with fixed traditional tabs and live-only source controls
failed-primary detail can choose known candidates before fetch completes
grouped search with natural names and retained alternate Videos
selected and first-visible stable work-key anchors with pixel offset
View-bound click/selection and retained ordinary duplicate-ID browsing
center DOWN/UP captured-model dispatch and canceled/old-query guards
preDraw transition cleanup, window focus loss, background and destruction
notes: Text/numeric comparison keys do not mutate titles, source identity or paging state; changed snapshots alone rebind cards.
Press handling captures the actual bound Video and dispatches the native click chain for that object; old adapter positions are not used to select a new title.
Window-focus loss cancels pressed state and releases deferred snapshots even when no Activity pause occurs.
Unified/search anchors use stable group keys; ordinary local/live browsing retains actual-object click membership, and late preferred sources keep old candidates reachable.
SetSelectionFromTop is available since API21 per the installed official SDK API table; physical D-pad/pixel-offset behavior remains untested.
